question: Does the frozen class-agnostic objects proposal, direct target-template mask-foreground FFA memory and native SAM2 refinement chain localize wholly new physical door 3 at IoU at least 0.5 in all three frozen query views?

predecessor.single_change: Move the frozen target-only FFA chain from consumed D13 to pre-download, pre-RGB, pre-model physical family 422885e9 -> 422885d4, target door 3.

proposal.selection: Full-frame class-agnostic GroundingDINO proposals, descending objectness with deterministic coordinate ties and no query truth access.

descriptor.feature: SAM-mask-weighted mean of normalized 37x37 DINOv2 patch tokens inside the unmasked RGB box crop, followed by L2 normalization.
descriptor.score: Maximum cosine to the three target FFA memories only; no sibling subtraction, fitted scale or threshold.

masker.contract: Apply native SAM2 to each target-memory box and each retained objectness box, multimask false, zero mask threshold, no morphology or IoU-score selection. Use masks for FFA and the selected mask tight bbox for evaluation.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider target boxes enter only post-ranking proposal opportunity and tight-mask-box IoU evaluation.

decision_gate.interpretation: All three frames must contain a retained IoU-at-least-0.5 proposal and all three target-only FFA top-one masks must reach IoU at least 0.5.

literature_motivation.use: Class-agnostic objects proposals, direct instance-template FFA matching and SAM refinement.

forbidden_after_freeze: change images, proposal prompt/threshold/cap, descriptor, target-only formula, SAM settings or IoU gate
use sibling appearance or provider query boxes to generate, filter, resize, merge, rank or prompt proposals
retry, replace a frame or add any post-outcome rescue on this family
claim_boundary: A pass can establish only narrow same-provider new-family confirmation that the frozen target-only FFA pipeline acquires and localizes one bound physical door from full query frames. Same-provider geometry selected reference boxes. It cannot establish calibrated open-set absence, broad distractor coverage, raw-phone or provider-independent generalization, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
